question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words in the following sentence.**

She is really interested in __the study of religion.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **theology**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Theology **is the study of the nature of God and religious belief; it involves the rational inquiry into questions of religion, spirituality, and the divine. (धर्मशास्र)

 
 
• **Example**: *In his theology classes, the students explore various religious texts, doctrines, and philosophies to deepen their understanding of different faith traditions.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Philology**: The study of language in written historical sources. (भाषाशास्त्र)
 
• **Lexicography**: The practice of compiling dictionaries or the scholarly discipline of analyzing and describing the vocabulary of a particular language. (कोशरचना)
 
• **Psephology**: The study of elections, including the analysis of electoral behaviour, voting patterns, and electoral systems. (चुनाव विश्लेषण)
